altimate-code is a fork of OpenCode rebuilt for data teams. Model-agnostic — bring your own LLM or run locally with Ollama.
|**Builder**|Create dbt models, SQL pipelines, and data transformations|Full read/write (write SQL prompts for approval; `DROP DATABASE`/`DROP SCHEMA`/`TRUNCATE` hard-blocked)|

The open-source CLI for PgStack. PgStack Access provides temporary, recorded access to PostgreSQL. Start a session from your terminal, then connect with `psql` or your favorite database client.

The installer downloads a standalone executable from this repository's GitHub Releases, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and installs it to `~/.local/bin/pgstack`. No Node.js or Bun installation is required. Add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH` if needed. Re-run the installer to upgrade.

Lunora gives you Convex-style DX on infrastructure you control. You write type-safe queries, mutations, and actions in TypeScript. In production, Lunora deploys them as Cloudflare Workers: Durable Objects hold real-time state, D1 handles SQL, R2 stores blobs, and Queues run jobs. Nothing runs on servers we operate; the production stack lives in the Cloudflare account you already pay for. See Where it runs for the other targets.

> **Alpha.** The npm package is `lunorash` because the unscoped `lunora` name is taken; the CLI it installs is still called `lunora`. Install from the `@alpha` dist-tag and expect breaking changes until the first stable release (see Status).
> Prefer managed hosting, or just want one email when v1 is stable? **Join the Lunora Cloud waitlist →**

**Clients aren't limited to JavaScript.** There are adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Angular, and React Native, and `lunora sdk generate` writes typed clients for Python, Go, Ruby, Rust, Swift, Java, Kotlin, and Dart (see `sdks/`).
|Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects|Production|Deploying your app|
|Node (`@lunora/platform-node`)|Dev and test|Local runs and tests. Not a production target.|
|Self-hosted on celld (`@lunora/platform-celld`)|Experimental|Self-hosting on machines you run|
